structure: Title → one-liner → badge row → banner image
best_for: apps with a visual identity; landing-quality front page
example:
# Vite

Next-generation frontend tooling
[badges: npm version, CI, license]
[banner: gradient wordmark over dark background]

structure: Title → one-liner → badge row → UI screenshot
best_for: apps and tools with a GUI; screenshots answer 'what does it look like' instantly
example:
# Excalidraw

Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn diagrams
[badges]
[screenshot: canvas with a few doodles]

structure: Title → one-liner → badge row → install command immediately
best_for: libraries and CLIs where the reader wants to try it in 30 seconds
example:
# zod

TypeScript-first schema validation
[badges]
`npm install zod`

structure: Title → one-liner → 'the problem' paragraph → 'the solution' paragraph
best_for: developer tools whose value isn't obvious from the name
example:
# ripgrep

recursively searches directories for a regex pattern
[badges]
[some context: grep is slow over large trees; rg is faster and respects .gitignore]

structure: Title → one-liner → badge row → looping demo GIF
best_for: TUIs and CLIs where motion shows the workflow better than text
example:
# lazygit

simple terminal UI for git commands
[badges]
[GIF: staging, committing, pushing from the TUI]

structure: Title → one-liner → badge row → 'why not X' comparison table
best_for: tools entering an established space where users will ask 'vs. the existing thing'
example:
# Bun

Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime
[badges]
[table: bun vs node vs deno on install/run/test speed]
